steps.player: Hello, what do you do around here?

steps.npc: The name's Ishmael. I sell fishing supplies, along with some of the local catch.

options.text: Can I take a look at what you have in stock?

steps.player: Can I take a look at what you have in stock?

options.text: Why did you set up shop around here? Seems a little run down.

steps.player: Why did you set up shop around here? It seems a little run down.

steps.npc: Argh... run down it is! But since Tempoross showed up, seadogs from all across Gielinor have been coming to wrangle the beast. It only made sense to sell off our spare resources.
